`runScheduled()` in `src/exports/scheduler.ts` now logs progress with `console.log`. I haven't run it or type-checked it.

- **Job start:** it logs `[scheduler] starting job <id>`.
- **Job finish:** it logs `[scheduler] finished job <id>: <url> (<n> left in queue)`.

The "left" count is measured after the job has been taken off the queue. The last job therefore reports 0 left.

The file had no logger, so I used `console.log`. If your project has a logging utility, tell me and I'll switch to it.
